documents.index_text: This reel joins two dated source types: a commissioned corporate review’s compensation total and a later Senate chairman’s questions about how those payments were calculated and substantiated. One is not a court validation of the other. The payment record does not establish a crime. Dechert described tax and estate work and said it found no evidence tying the payments to Epstein’s criminal activity; it was a commissioned review, not a court verdict. The 2023 Senate questions are not adjudicated findings. The later $170 million Senate total is a different scope from the review’s $158 million and must not be silently substituted.
